URL: https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog-july-27-2026/
(WebFetch; Times of Israel newsroom liveblog, 27 July 2026)

- PM Netanyahu and his wife Sara boarded a plane to Washington on 27 July 2026; travel described as occurring "secretively" amid reported Iranian security threats.
- Trump told Axios: "We are in very deep talks with Iran. If they don't work out, we will go back to very strong military action."
- Trump: "Either it goes fast or not at all" (on the diplomatic timeline).
- Trump on the meeting: "I am going to talk to Bibi about the fact that if I weren't president, Iran would have had nuclear weapons by now."
- A regional official described mediation as "significant" progress, with Qatar and Pakistan leading indirect US-Iran negotiations.
- Gaza: cabinet gave initial approval for an international force of approximately 200 troops.
- IDF reported killing Islamic Jihad member Amro Abu Alrish, involved in hostage handovers.
- Israel released 60 Gazan detainees, described as the largest single batch released during the ceasefire period.
- Security officials warned Iran may attempt to target Israeli election candidates.
